# Republican support for Trump has fallen as Democrats hold a big lead among enthusiastic midterms voters

David Montgomery-August 18, 2026

According to this week's Economist / YouGov Poll, about one-third (35%) of Americans strongly or somewhat approve of Donald Trump's job performance as president, and 61% disapprove. That's a net job approval of -26, up slightly from -29 last week. [...] Trump has maintained strong support from Republicans who are MAGA supporters. Just 39% of registered voters approve of Trump’s job performance, while 58% disapprove, putting him 19 points underwater, as detailed in a Noble Predictive Insights poll released Thursday. The net minus-19 rating drops below his previous low of minus-13, recorded after Jan. 6, 2021.

Trump receives a net minus-25 on both the economy and his handling of military operations in Iran, according to the poll results.
